preconditions.description: The number of teams n must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k * n % 2 != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the total number of wins is odd, output -1 indicating no valid tournament.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in matches)
postconditions.description: All matches must involve valid team numbers and different teams.
